highlights: close to local schools and amenities
summary: Offered to the market with the considerable advantage of no onward chain, this well-presented two-bedroom semi-detached home provides comfortable and versatile accommodation, together with gardens and off-road parking
description:
Ideally suited to a wide range of buyers, the property would make an excellent purchase for first-time buyers, couples, young families or those looking to downsize. The property is particularly well positioned for families, being situated within close proximity to a selection of local primary, junior and secondary schools, making it a convenient choice for those with children of different ages. A range of local amenities, shops and everyday conveniences are also readily accessible, whilst excellent transport links provide ease of access to surrounding areas for both work and leisure. Internally, the property offers well-proportioned accommodation arranged over two floors and briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a comfortable lounge providing an ideal space for relaxing, together with a kitchen/dining room offering a practical and sociable area for everyday family life and entertaining. To the rear, a useful garden room provides an additional versatile space, which could be utilised in a variety of ways according to individual requirements, including as a home office, playroom, hobby space or further sitting area. To the first floor, the property provides two bedrooms, together with a family bathroom. Externally, the property benefits from lawned garden areas to both the front and rear, providing pleasant outdoor space for relaxing and enjoying the warmer months. Off-road parking further adds to the practicality and convenience of the home. Offering a well-positioned home with comfortable accommodation, gardens, parking and the significant benefit of no onward chain, this property is likely to appeal to a wide range of buyers. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the accommodation, versatility and convenient location on offer.

ENTRANCE HALL Accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed entrance door, the welcoming entrance hallway provides a practical introduction to the accommodation and access to the principal living areas. Stairs rise to the first-floor accommodation, whilst a further doorway leads directly into the lounge. The hallway provides a natural and convenient entrance to this well-presented family home.

LOUNGE A comfortable and inviting lounge, forming part of the property's open-plan living arrangement and flowing seamlessly into the kitchen/dining room. This sociable layout creates a versatile space ideally suited to both everyday family life and entertaining. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light into the room, whilst a radiator provides warmth and comfort. The open-plan arrangement further enhances the sense of space and allows the lounge to connect naturally with the adjoining kitchen and dining areas.

KITCHEN / DINING ROOM The kitchen forms part of the property's sociable open-plan living arrangement and is fitted with a range of white base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces. Features include an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, integrated oven and hob with overhead chimney-style extractor, together with plumbing for an automatic washing machine. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window provides natural light to the kitchen area, whilst the adjoining dining space offers ample room for a table and chairs, creating a practical area for everyday dining and entertaining. A wall-mounted column radiator provides warmth, with a further UPVC-framed double-glazed window allowing additional natural light into the room. UPVC-framed double-glazed sliding patio doors provide access into the garden room, creating a natural flow between the internal living accommodation and the additional outdoor-inspired reception space.

GARDEN ROOM

A useful and versatile additional reception space, the garden room benefits from a wealth of natural light through UPVC-framed double-glazed windows and doors. Double-glazed doors provide direct access to the rear garden, creating a pleasant connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces and making this an ideal area for relaxing, entertaining or enjoying the garden throughout the year.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first-floor landing provides access to both bedrooms and the family bathroom, creating a practical central area connecting the upper-floor accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE A comfortable bedroom offering a pleasant and practical space for a variety of bedroom furniture and furnishings. The room benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light into the room, together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort.

BEDROOM TWO A further comfortable bedroom offering a practical and versatile space for a range of bedroom furniture and furnishings. The room benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light into the room, together with a radiator providing warmth and comfort.

FAMILY BATHROOM A well-appointed family bathroom, fitted with a contemporary white suite comprising a panelled bath, wash hand basin set into a vanity unit and low-level WC. The room benefits from easy-clean panelled walls, providing a practical and modern finish, whilst a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light into the room. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, completing this practical family bathroom.

EXTERNALLY To the frontage, the property benefits from a pleasant fence-enclosed lawned garden, providing an attractive approach to the home and enjoying gated access. A side gated access leads through to the rear garden, where there is a patio area providing an ideal space for outdoor seating and entertaining. Beyond this is a further lawned garden, again enclosed by fencing, creating a private and practical outdoor space for relaxation and enjoyment. Double gated access provides entry to the rear, offering the valuable benefit of off-road parking and further enhancing the practicality of this well-presented semi-detached home.
